contexts.text: Man then passes from an obscure life into a clear one; and they who are in faith in the Lord, into one more and more clear.
Spirits speak so acutely and clearly...
The clearness of the perception (of women).
He who is in good is in the capacity of clearly seeing the truths which How from general principles... Spirits who had not been so clearsighted while they lived in this world...
After death, man can think and speak... much more clearly than in the bodily life.
Material things... remove from the Spiritual World, whence comes all clearsightedness.
What is genuine and clear. Signified.

Good is said to be clear when it becomes truth... The more therefore that good is presented in a better form, the more clearly it appears... It is the understanding which forms the Voluntary, and presents it clear.
Bruised and ground = good clear; in the opposite, evil clear.
They who are on high can clearly see those who are below...
The capacity of being wise... is the capacity of clearly seeing what is true and good...
